PREMIUM SYNTHETIC ATF - LV FLUID
A special blend of full-synthetic base oils combined with a multi-purpose additive package system that
provides superior anti-wear protection and performance in virtually all types of passenger and commercial
automatic transmissions that require newer “low-viscosity” fluid.
Part # 0413X (AVAILABLE SIZES - 1 GAL OR 55 GAL)
